The actual checker passed 2530 exact rational assertions. Finitary calculations not used as proof of mixing.

value.rationale: The pair leaf count and total search cost is an intrinsic algorithmic/tree-geometry comparison with different fluctuation scales. Exact negative finite covariance alongside mixing against the full infinite history explains multiscale decoupling stronger than vanishing correlation, not implied by either of the known marginal limit theorems. Uniform attachment is a natural canonical model and the finite formula identifies the sharp covariance and correlation scale. General weighted cases and quantitative mixing rates are outside the claim.
